<Heading

>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reports/throughput"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns one row per (pathId, hour bucket) in the half-open window [from, to), ordered by hour bucket then path. An empty window is a 200 with an empty `rows` array, not a 404.

`rateDeviationDetected` is reserved: no use case raises RateDeviationDetected today (no ADR defines the rule), so the column is 0 in every row.
